notes: Alpha.15 unifies the bundled/runtime/profile DSH generation on 0.1.5-rc.2 and Mobile Context 0.2.2. Existing rc.1 installations use a recovery-checkpointed A/B upgrade path and preserve user-owned profile fields while replacing only APK-managed runtime/plugin dependencies. WebView diagnostics now record provider/version, navigation, HTTP/network failures, JavaScript console output, renderer death and DOM/crypto health with token redaction; Settings can explicitly copy or open the current DSH browser URL for comparison. Runtime logs now carry readable local timestamps. Validation passes for Android/Robolectric unit tests, Mobile Context contract, ARM64 Alpine Runtime E2E including embedded/offline and fallback paths, mobile-size Chromium UI interactions at 390x844, Android lint, clean-commit Android build from source commit 1ba59cb9c7791a549396b65424ad698f1ae0b2fa, byte-identical release packaging and stable signing. Physical OriginOS WebView rendering remains the manual release validation target.
